earlier_scan.note: Guale is unattested (no linguistic records); stress unknowable

sources.note: Nothing on stress; states only two words are known (micoo 'chief', Chiluques 'Cusabo'), that the vocabulary formerly taken as Guale is Muscogee (Sturtevant 1994), and that Domingo Agustín Váez's 1569 Guale grammar is lost.
